cli.intro: OpenPCB — create, edit, inspect and export PCB board documents on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create a native board document and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a board document and print its committed revision and layers
cmd.import: Import a KiCad PCB file into a native board document
cmd.list: List the revision, stackup and object counts of a board document
cmd.undo: Restore the previous snapshot and write the document back in place
cmd.redo: Reapply the next snapshot and write the document back in place
cmd.inspect: Run design rule and layout checks on a board document
cmd.export: Project a board document to a fabrication, assembly or exchange format
cmd.footprint: Edit the footprints of a board document
cmd.footprint-add: Place a footprint and write the document back in place
cmd.footprint-delete: Delete a footprint by id and write the document back in place
cmd.footprint-move: Move or re-layer a footprint and write the document back in place
cmd.footprint-update: Update the value or package of a footprint in place
cmd.footprint-pad: Edit the pads of a footprint
cmd.footprint-pad-add: Add a pad to a footprint and write the document back in place
cmd.footprint-pad-update: Update the geometry or net of a pad in place
cmd.footprint-pad-delete: Delete a pad from a footprint in place
cmd.track: Edit the tracks of a board document
cmd.track-add: Route a track segment and write the document back in place
cmd.track-update: Update the net, layer, width or endpoints of a track in place
cmd.track-delete: Delete a track by id and write the document back in place
cmd.via: Edit the vias of a board document
cmd.via-add: Place a via and write the document back in place
cmd.via-update: Update the net, position, diameter or drill of a via in place
cmd.via-delete: Delete a via by id and write the document back in place
cmd.slot: Edit the plated routed slots of a board document
cmd.slot-add: Add a plated routed slot and write the document back in place
cmd.slot-delete: Delete a slot by id and write the document back in place
cmd.zone: Edit the copper pour regions of a board document
cmd.zone-add: Add a copper pour polygon and write the document back in place
cmd.zone-update: Resize or re-layer a copper pour region in place
cmd.zone-list: Print the area and perimeter of every copper pour region
cmd.zone-delete: Delete a copper pour region by id and write the document back in place
cmd.text: Edit the silkscreen text items of a board document
cmd.text-add: Add a silkscreen legend and write the document back in place
cmd.text-update: Update the content, layer or metrics of a silkscreen legend in place
cmd.text-delete: Delete a silkscreen legend by id and write the document back in place
cmd.text-list: Print every silkscreen legend with its position and metrics
cmd.drill: Report the drill tools and hits of a board document
cmd.drill-report: Print holes, slots and tools grouped by finished diameter
cmd.keepout: Edit the copper keepout regions of a board document
cmd.keepout-add: Add a copper keepout polygon and write the document back in place
cmd.keepout-delete: Delete a keepout region by id and write the document back in place
cmd.keepout-update: Resize or re-layer a keepout region in place
cmd.keepout-list: Print the area and perimeter of every keepout region
cmd.net: Edit the nets of a board document
cmd.netclass: Edit the net classes of a board document
cmd.netclass-add: Declare a net class and write the document back in place
cmd.netclass-delete: Delete a net class by id and write the document back in place
cmd.netclass-assign: Move one net into a net class and write the document back in place
cmd.testpoint: Edit the test points of a board document
cmd.testpoint-add: Declare a test point on a pad or via and write the document back in place
cmd.testpoint-delete: Delete a test point by id and write the document back in place
cmd.net-add: Declare a net and write the document back in place
cmd.route: Route every net with at least two pads and write the document back in place
cmd.stitch: Generate a stitching via fence along the inset board outline
cmd.layer: Edit the stackup layers of a board document
cmd.layer-add: Add a layer and write the document back in place
cmd.layer-rename: Rename a layer, updating every reference, in place
cmd.layer-visible: Set layer visibility and write the document back in place
cmd.layer-lock: Lock or unlock a layer in place
cmd.outline-set: Set a rectangular board outline in place
cmd.rules: Read or edit the design rules of a board document
cmd.rules-show: Print the design-rule values used by the checks and writers
cmd.rules-set: Replace one or more design-rule values in place
cmd.stackup: Read, set or evaluate the physical stackup
cmd.stackup-set: Declare copper thickness, dielectric height and permittivity in place
cmd.stackup-impedance: Compute the single-ended impedance of one trace
cmd.stackup-width: Convert a target impedance to a controlled trace width
cmd.waiver-add: Waive one finding code, optionally narrowed to one object
cmd.severity-set: Override the severity of one finding code
cmd.severity-delete: Remove the severity override of one finding code
cmd.copper: Report copper area and layer balance
cmd.copper-balance: Print copper area per layer and the coverage imbalance
cmd.gui: Open the OpenPCB Studio window on the native board

opt.out: File or directory to write; Gerber export writes a directory of layer files
opt.title: Board title
opt.template: Template the board starts from; blank is the only implemented value
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: drc, connectivity, clearance, annular_rings, annular-ring, track-width, unrouted, stackup, outline, silkscreen, courtyard, netlist, hole-to-hole, copper-to-edge, edge-clearance, silkscreen-over-pad, diffpair, dangling-copper, netclass, keepout, via-in-pad
opt.format: Export target: gbr, drl, drill_map, bom, pos, placement, testpoints, ipc_d_356, svg, pdf, png, kicad_pcb and ipc2581 are implemented; step is not
opt.id: Stable object id, for example fp-1
opt.footprint-id: Footprint id that owns the pad, for example fp-1
opt.pad-number: Pad number or name, unique within the footprint
opt.via: Via copper diameter used by the router
opt.spacing: Target spacing between adjacent stitching vias along the perimeter
opt.inset: Distance from the board edge to the stitching ring
opt.slot-width: Slot tool diameter, equal to the cut width, in mm
opt.from-layer: Top copper layer of a blind or buried via
opt.to-layer: Bottom copper layer of a blind or buried via
opt.name: Net or layer name
opt.kind: Layer kind: copper, silkscreen, soldermask, assembly or mechanical
opt.visible: Layer visibility as true or false
opt.locked: Layer lock state as true or false
opt.points: Closed polygon as at least three x,y points separated by spaces or semicolons
opt.text-thickness: Legend stroke thickness in board units
opt.via-diameter: Minimum via copper diameter required by a net class
opt.via-drill: Minimum via finished drill required by a net class
opt.hole-clearance: Minimum gap between two drill holes of different nets, in mm
opt.solder-mask-expansion: Solder-mask expansion around each pad, per side and in mm
opt.dielectric-height: Dielectric thickness between adjacent copper layers, in mm
opt.dielectric-constant: Relative permittivity of the dielectric; at least 1
opt.code: Stable finding code, for example drc/track-width-too-small
opt.object: Object id the waiver is narrowed to; omit to cover every object
opt.severity: New severity: info, warning or error
